title: js2264/plexembler pipeline parameters
description: Reference genomes, gene annotations, Hi-C maps and expression tables for every species of a pool, from per-species nanopore reads and pooled Hi-C, WGS and RNA-seq

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: The species and the pooled libraries, and where the results go.

input.description: The species samplesheet: one row per nanopore run of a species.
input.help_text: A CSV file with a header: species, pool, ont (FASTQ, or Dorado's unaligned BAM), and optionally chemistry, genome_size, ploidy, n_chromosomes, busco_lineage, genetic_code, telomere_repeat and assembler. A relative path in it is read from the samplesheet's folder. See the [usage page](https://js2264.github.io/plexembler/usage/#species).

libraries.description: The pooled libraries samplesheet: one row per pair of FASTQ files of a Hi-C, WGS or RNA-seq library made from a pool of species.
libraries.help_text: A CSV file with a header: library, pool, type (hic, wgs or rnaseq), fastq_1, fastq_2, and optionally condition and replicate (rnaseq), enzymes (hic). A relative path in it is read from the samplesheet's folder. See the [usage page](https://js2264.github.io/plexembler/usage/#pooled-libraries).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

contigs_options.title: Contigs
contigs_options.description: Each species' nanopore reads, its assemblies as candidates, their polishing and checks, and the one kept (milestone 1).

ont_min_length.description: The shortest nanopore read kept, in bases.

ont_min_quality.description: The lowest mean quality of a nanopore read kept; by default 10 for R10 reads, 7 for R9.

ont_max_depth.description: The depth the nanopore reads are capped at, from the genome size; the longest and best reads are kept. 0 for no cap.
ont_max_depth.help_text: Filtlong keeps `ont_max_depth` times the genome size, in bases: the samplesheet's `genome_size`, or LRGE's estimate when it is NA.

save_ont_reads.description: Save each species' nanopore reads as they were assembled: filtered and capped.

assemblers.description: The assemblers that run, comma-separated: each one's contigs are a candidate (flye, hifiasm).
assemblers.help_text: Every candidate is renamed, polished and checked; `plexembler select` keeps one, by BUSCO's single-copy genes, then the QV, then the contig N50, unless the samplesheet's `assembler` names one. hifiasm runs in its `--ont` mode, for R10 reads.

ont_polisher.description: How the candidates are polished with their species' nanopore reads: medaka, dorado (experimental: a GPU, and Dorado's BAMs), or none.
ont_polisher.help_text: `dorado` runs `dorado polish` for the species whose `ont` is Dorado's unaligned BAM, and Medaka for the others. It is experimental until it has been tested on a GPU (docs/plan.md).

medaka_model.description: Medaka's model; by default r1041_e82_400bps_sup_v5.2.0 for R10 reads, r941_min_sup_g507 for R9.

busco_lineage.description: The BUSCO lineage of a species whose samplesheet's busco_lineage is NA: auto_euk to let BUSCO choose.

busco_db.description: A folder of BUSCO's lineages, downloaded beforehand (`busco --download`), for runs without network.

kmer_size.description: The k-mers' length, for Merqury's QV and completeness and GenomeScope2.

pool_options.title: The pool, split
pool_options.description: Each pooled library split between its pool's species, and each species polished with its own short reads (milestone 2).

deconvolve_mapq.description: A read's lowest mapping quality to be given to a species: below, it is ambiguous.

deconvolve_min_identity.description: A read's lowest identity to its species' contig: below, it is a read of another species.
deconvolve_min_identity.help_text: A read of a region missing from its own species' contigs aligns, unique, to a sister species' copy, 85 to 95 % identical: the identity, not the mapping quality, catches it (docs/plan.md, Decisions).

polish_reads.description: The short reads each species is polished with: auto (its WGS pairs, or its Hi-C reads cut at their junctions when its pool has no WGS library), wgs or hic.

sr_polisher.description: Short-read polishing: Polypolish, then pypolca, kept only if it raises the QV; or none.

polish_holdout.description: The share of each library's pairs kept apart from the polishing, whose k-mers the QV guard counts against.

save_split_reads.description: Save each species' split reads, of each pooled library.

chromosomes_options.title: Chromosomes
chromosomes_options.description: Each species scaffolded with its own Hi-C pairs, its scaffolds named, and its Hi-C map (milestone 3).

min_chromosome.description: A species without n_chromosomes: the shortest scaffold named a chromosome, in bases.
min_chromosome.help_text: When the samplesheet gives a species' n_chromosomes, its longest scaffolds, that many, are its chromosomes; the others are unplaced (docs/output.md, The genome).

map_resolution.description: The finest bin of each species' Hi-C map, in bases; the map is zoomed out from it.

annotation_options.title: Annotation
annotation_options.description: Each species' repeats, genes and non-coding RNAs, and each pooled RNA-seq library split between the species (milestone 4).

repeats.description: Each species' repeats: found de novo (RepeatModeler) and masked soft (RepeatMasker), or none.

gene_predictor.description: Each species' genes: BRAKER3 (--fungus) with its RNA-seq alignments and --orthodb_proteins, AUGUSTUS ab initio for a species with neither; augustus for AUGUSTUS alone; or none.
gene_predictor.help_text: BRAKER3 trains GeneMark and AUGUSTUS on the species itself, from its RNA-seq, related proteins, or both. A species with neither is predicted ab initio by AUGUSTUS with --augustus_species, a species it was trained on.

augustus_species.description: The species AUGUSTUS predicts ab initio with: one it was trained on (augustus --species=help), as close as can be.

orthodb_proteins.description: Proteins of related species for BRAKER3, such as OrthoDB's partition of the fungi (Fungi.fa.gz).

expression_options.title: Expression and tracks
expression_options.description: Each species' counts and TPM, genes by RNA-seq libraries, and its coverage tracks (milestone 5).

rnaseq_strandedness.description: The pooled RNA-seq libraries' strandedness: reverse (dUTP, Illumina's stranded kits), forward, or unstranded.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
